purpose: Official OEM source access and rights boundary for VAG-specific diagnostics and repair/maintenance data

products.publisher: Volkswagen Group Info Services AG / Volkswagen Group R&D departments

package_scope.worldwide_market_coverage: additional platforms outside EU; exact list requires authenticated package

data_content: platform-consolidated coverage across 8 VAG Group brands

access.delivery: static ZIP download; API download endpoint; no push/pull
access.automation_api: current access via static download; further automation details provided during onboarding

rights.terms_scope: Authorized customers may use OEM DTC/ODX in their own products subject to contract; further use and remarketing are not permitted.

applicability.exact_model_year_market_coverage: requires package contents and platform mapping

limitations: Only companies headquartered in the EEA, Switzerland or UK are eligible; Russian market and Russian-headquartered companies are not listed as eligible.
The product requires a subscription, Data Hub onboarding, an SFD agreement and a second Volkswagen AG agreement for encryption keys.
Data is delivered as ODX files per ECU in static ZIP packages; current product documentation says API automation is not yet available as a push/pull feed.
Use in authorized customers' own products/tools is subject to terms; further use and remarketing are not permitted.
No right to redistribute a pre-populated offline SQLite database was independently established.
No account, API key, subscription, agreement or data download was created.

evidence_reviewed.evidence: Eight VAG Group brands, DTC descriptions/reference values, 70 EU platforms or 75 worldwide platforms, EEA/UK/CH markets, twice-yearly updates, eligible-company and agreement requirements, ODX delivery and further-use restrictions.
EU package requires Data Hub onboarding, subscription and marketplace API key; GET latest/download endpoints.
Worldwide static diagnostics package requires onboarding and subscription; GET latest/download endpoints.
ZIP download gated by API key.

data_content: vehicle identification via additional licensed products

rights.terms_scope: Contractual redistribution is available only to authorized eligible customers under the RMI licence and EU 2018/858; Russia is explicitly excluded.

applicability.repair_procedure_fitment: requires licensed RMI source records and platform/VIN/model applicability

limitations: The licence page explicitly excludes Russia from the markets for which the worldwide licence can be requested.
The FAQ limits eligible company headquarters to the EEA, Switzerland or UK.
A central RMI licence is required for third-party product integration, plus a separate paid erWin account for each brand to obtain the XML/PDF data.
No direct API is available; data is obtained through erWin.
Redistribution is contractually permitted only for authorized eligible customers under the RMI licence and EU Regulation 2018/858; this does not apply to an unlicensed Russian-market app.
No account, licence, erWin subscription or data download was created.

evidence_reviewed.evidence: Third-party RMI licence covers repair guides, circuit diagrams, component locations, maintenance, chassis repair and work steps; default EU scope; worldwide request excludes Russia; XML/PDF via erWin, no API; authorized redistribution subject to contract.
New erWin is paid time-based B2B access for independent workshops; company account and market/brand licences; connected OEM frontends, not a data feed.

rights.use_scope: licensed professional workshop access within selected brand and market
rights.terms_scope: Direct licensed workshop access only; no data-feed, offline-cache or third-party redistribution right identified.

applicability.precision: brand_market_and_OEM_frontend_context; VIN/model matching inside OEM systems
applicability.exact_engine_gearbox_mapping: available only within authorized OEM frontend if supported

limitations: The portal is paid, time-based B2B access for professional workshops.
It directs users into OEM-operated frontends and does not provide a data feed/API for third-party offline SQLite ingestion.
No automated extraction, offline caching or third-party redistribution right was identified for this direct-access product.
Exact market rollout varies by country and is not established for Russia/EAEU.
No company account, licence or data download was created.

evidence_reviewed.evidence: Central portal for eight brands; paid time-based brand/market licences; business account; direct access to connected OEM systems; no data feed API.
Portal transition and company account requirements reviewed.

global_decision: No product data downloaded or imported. All three sources require contractual access; RMI explicitly excludes Russia. Do not create accounts, accept paid terms, sign agreements or ingest data without owner approval and confirmed distribution scope.
